summary: The study describes the atomic layer deposition (ALD) of CH3NH3PbI3 perovskite thin films. The process involves depositing a PbS seed layer using ALD with H2S and Pb(tmhd)2 precursors, followed by conversion to PbI2 through iodine gas exposure and subsequent conversion to CH3NH3PbI3 via dip in methylammonium iodide (MAI) solution. The ALD process ensures controlled thickness, high purity, and crystallographic orientation of the films.
evidence: ALD of lead sulﬁ de has yielded thin ﬁ lms with controlled thickness, high purity, and distinct crystallographic orientations.
